CauseRemedy.Cause: A mapping Parameter is not supported of this Device.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please check, your mapping Configuration.

DiagMessage.MessageText: DynPdo BitMapping Warning: Object 0x%x/%x is not next to Object 0x%x/%x. (SyncManager %u)

CauseRemedy.Cause: A mapping Parameter is not supported of this Device.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please check, your mapping Configuration.

DiagMessage.MessageText: DynPdo BitMapping Warning: Can not Transform Bit-Mappings to Byte-Mappings. (SyncManager %u)

CauseRemedy.Cause: A mapping Parameter is not supported of this Device.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please check, your mapping Configuration.

DiagMessage.MessageText: DynPdo Mapping Warning: Invalid Oversampling Factor (%u) Object 0x%x/%x (SyncManager %u).
DiagMessage.Description: The oversampling factor of the mentioned Object is not possible.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The Number of samples is higher than the Sync1/Sync0 ratio.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please check, your mapping Configuration.

CauseRemedy.Cause: Sync1/Sync0 ratio divided through the number of samples is not integer.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please check, your mapping Configuration.

DiagMessage.MessageText: DynPdo Mapping Warning: Oversampling is not allowed for Object 0x%x/%x (SyncManager %u).
DiagMessage.Description: Oversampling is not allowed for the mentioned Object.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The mapping parameters contain oversampling for an object which doesn't support oversampling.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please check, your mapping Configuration.

DiagMessage.MessageText: DynPdo Assignment Warning: Assignment 0x%x%x contains a Pdo 0x%x which doesn't exist.
DiagMessage.Description: The Pdo Assignment List contains a Pdo which doesn't exist.

CauseRemedy.Cause: You might have used a Debug XML-Description in your actual Project.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please refresh your XML-Description and insert a new Instance of this Device in your Project.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Safe-Op is not possible because the local TwinCAT Runtime is in ConfigMode.
DiagMessage.Description: You should only see this Message, if you are a AX Developer.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The internal TwinCAT Runtime is in ConfigMode.

DiagMessage.MessageText: Transition Pre-Op to Safe-Op not successful. Safetycard not detected.

CauseRemedy.Cause: There is an internal hardware error.
CauseRemedy.Remedy: Send the AX8000 to the Beckhoff branch office that is responsible for you.

CauseRemedy.Remedy: Please switch the 24V supply voltage of this device off and on.

CauseRemedy.Cause: The device is in a fatal error state and not able to operate.
